rules.body: Apply when an operation owns a retained asynchronous record source consumed through sequential next operations and terminated through asynchronous close; README.md states, "Producer cleanup can suspend; the producer is retained independently of the consumer."

Treat first match, source exhaustion, a row marked cancelled, and predicate failure as terminal observations. On each, select the original outcome and request close exactly once before acknowledging that outcome.

Keep terminal acknowledgement pending while close is pending. After close succeeds, preserve the selected outcome: matching value, null for exhaustion, CancellationException for cancellation, or the original predicate failure.

Preserve source order by allowing only one next request at a time, evaluating its row before deciding whether to terminate, and requesting another row only when the current row is nonterminal and unmatched. This implements TASK: "Repair the record scan in Controller in src/Workflow.java while preserving scan order and error behavior."
Guard the terminal transition before requesting close so late asynchronous callbacks cannot request duplicate cleanup or replace the already-selected result, cancellation, or failure.
Do not start another read after observing match, exhaustion, cancellation, or predicate failure, and do not acknowledge any terminal outcome before suspending cleanup succeeds.

Verify every documented terminal path requests close once; an unresolved close keeps completion unresolved; successful close releases the previously selected outcome; unmatched records remain strictly sequential; and public Java sources compile with OpenJDK 11.

The existing finishing guard identifies the single terminal transition and should protect cleanup and acknowledgement from duplication.

first_match owns a supplied retained asynchronous record source and a supplied predicate.
The source has next/aclose asynchronous operations; cancellation interrupts a suspended read, and cleanup may suspend.

void scan(){env.resolve("next",key,null).thenAccept(v->{Map<String,Object> row=(Map<String,Object>)v;if(Boolean.TRUE.equals(row.get("cancelled"))){finish("cancelled",null,null);return;}if(Boolean.TRUE.equals(row.get("done"))){finish("return",null,null);return;}try{if(predicate.test(row.get("value")))finish("return",row.get("value"),null);else scan();}catch(Throwable error){finish("error",null,error);}});}
void finish(String terminal,Object value,Throwable error){if(finishing)return;finishing=true;kind=terminal;result=value;failure=error;
if(false&&(!false||value!=null)){CompletableFuture<Object> cleanup=env.resolve("close",key,null);if(false)cleanup.thenRun(acknowledge);else acknowledge.run();}else acknowledge.run();
